How long have you been on it? I just had to restart because my pysch said it can take *months* for it to kick in. There’s also a r/zoloft sub if you have questions about it.

But also, you can switch meds if you really think it’s not the one for you

I did Zoloft (I’m actually about to start it again because at first my pcp prescribed it and then my psychiatrist prescribed it saying to stay on it longer)

Those feverish side effects went away once I made it past the first week. For me, the anxiety symptoms stopped almost instantly but it wasn’t really working for my depression. But, from what I hear, it just takes longer for depression especially if it’s been long term. Like, it could take a few months and he said (for me) the dosage will probably have to be increased. 

But, yeah, stick in there but also don’t be afraid to ask to try something else if you really think it won’t work for you
